cases.question: My plot is 200 sq m on a 9 m road. How much gap do I leave at the front, how many floors can I build, and what fee do I pay?
cases.answer:
Front open space: 3 m for a street 9 m wide (Rule 56(1)(a)).
Rear open space: 2.5 m for a plot of 200 sq m (Rule 56(2)(a)).
A plot of 200 sq m fits these types under Rule 53(1): semi-detached building, row-type building.
Side open space for a semi-detached building: 3 m on one side (Rule 56(3)).
Side open space for a row-type building: none required (Nil) (Rule 56(3)).
Maximum built-up area: 250 s
